text:
I wanted to give this place a higher rating, but it just wasn't justified for my experience. I had the bedeviled sandwich and fries with spicy rub. The bedeviled sandwich is a take on an egg salad sandwich using tofu, served on rye and with tomato. I love the concept but I think the execution wasn't on point. The tofu mixture was too salty and too mustard-y. The fries tasted good, but were super soggy. They were limp like noodles. I was disappointed with the meal overall, but I do want to give them another try and reevaluate.

The location of this restaurant is in a fun area with several of trendy shops, cafes, and restaurants. It was a neat place to walk around and I bet it can be quite lively when things are back to normal. They do currently have outdoor seating available.

*Update*
I returned to Beaut Burger to try their burger and cauli bites. The burger was not for me (if I am eating a veg burger, I prefer the Impossible burger). The texture seemed more like a bean burger and was very soft. The burger I had did have nice flavors with a little bit of spice from the green peppers. However, I would have liked more toppings; the ratio of bun/burger to toppings seemed off. The bun itself is interesting. It's like a toasted english muffin almost. It would be nice if it was a bit softer because biting through it caused the burger to squish out the back. Alright, now the cauli bites. Those were so delicious and I would totally get them again! I was surprised with how crisp the f
Late night, fast and delicious!! Quick service. Delivery guy was very professional and polite.

I have been "going" here for takeout during COVID.  The wings here are very good.  They have a lot of meat on them.  I get 5 of the red hot wings and 5 of the garlic Parmesan.  The red hot ones are the hottest that this place has and they are not for the faint of heart.  If you can taste past the heat, they have that nice sweetness that I like in hot wings.  You really need the blue cheese that goes with these.  As far as the garlic parm ones, they have plenty of garlic and come really sauced up.   The service is good as well.  We always go and pick these up.  The wait is not bad at all, and everyone is really friendly.  The only slight complaint that I have is that the servers sometimes are not wearing masks which really is not considerate to the guests.  They should all be wearing masks to protect the guests.

The bottom line is that Mesquito Grille is a great take out option during COVID.  There wings really shine and are without a doubt the best wings in Doylestown.

This was the first time I have eaten at this restaurant. From the moment we walked in I noticed that NO ONE had a mask on. Next thing I noticed was there was a table of 17 sitting all together. Then I notice that the ketchup, salt and pepper were all out on the tables and clearly were not cleaned after each use. If none of this bothers you during this COVID time then I say go for it. The food was good. If it does bother you then I would wait for a while.

Atmosphere is very smoky and you'll walk out smelling like a grill. So smoky that my sister in laws contacts were drying out. We had a 7pm reservation for a party of 10 to celebrate my mother in laws birthday. Checked in and had to wait about 7-10 minutes for them to set the table up. Upon sitting we were greeted by the waiter immediately for drink orders while we waited for the rest of our party. Drinks came out fast and he gave us a few to look over the menu. The kiddos ordered a cheeseburger with fries and Mac and cheese--when their food was delivered the entire entree wasn't delivered at once and despite me asking for ketchup and mustard when ordering their food that didn't make it out either. I had to ask 2 more times all the while my daughter sat there waiting to eat her cheeseburger and waited for her Mac and cheese since that didn't come out with her entree either. For kids you should really ensure the entire order comes out at the same time and ensure they have their ketchup!

Majority of our table ordered the sirloin which comes out on the heated lava rock for you to cook at the table. Per the waiter the rocks are heated in about six ovens that they have that run 24-7 and take about 8 hours to get fully hot. The steaks and seafood come out sizzling on the rock and the waiter goes over how long to cook the food and the best methods. Some people at our table ended up just slicing up their steak into strips and cooking it all then scooping over to the area on the side
Great place. Jazz band playing. Food and service was excellent.
Wow excellent food. Lucky to have found this find. Great BBQ. Very friendly. Ribs were excellent spicy slaw was great

This was the first restaurant my husband and I ate at since Covid. We chose this because he wanted octopus and offered outdoor seating. The outdoor seating was not maintained well, nor did it supply refuge from the sun. The only outdoor tables used were right at the entrance and people entering were close and unmasked. We ate inside requesting to be seated far from others for safety from exposure. The server arrived with only a sagging shield hanging very low, not covering her her nose and mouth completely. She made a comment about the virus being a hoax. The owner and a kitchen person came out, no masks in the presence of customers. The octopus was prepared well, the whole fried fish was VERY bland and tasteless. The soup was very good. Based on the attitude of the management and the feeling that they failed horribly to protect their customers, I will never give them my business even when Covid is over. I've lived in the area for 48 years, frequent Tarpon Springs and always bring our out of town guests. There are too many good restaurants who care about our business to support those who don't.

Despite them closing their dine in, we have ordered several times and absolutely love it. Their portions are BIG and the food is delicious. The wait hasn't been more than 20 minutes. I highly recommend them.

Brennan's is always fabulous for a fancy brunch in the heart of the French quarter. 

I started with the watermelon purée sparking wine drink. This was very refreshing and did not break the bank at $7 a glass. The fruit purée is seasonal, so it may not be watermelon next time you go. 

My fiancé and I split the crawfish cake appetizer. One of the best crawfish cakes that I have had- it included crawfish and crab. The picketed vegetables were a good balance.  

Finally, I had the pork Grillades. This was amazing - perfectly slow cooked and flavorful. It was hearty and filling. In fact, I only finished half of the pork before allowing my fiancé the rest. This was definitely most worthy of its price point.

I did try Scott's entree of Boudin and Andouille. It was good but to me, nothing special. Scott did really enjoy this dish. 

The service and atmosphere at Brennan's are classy and professional. 

Overall, 4/5 stars.  I did deduct one star due to pricing. It cost $100 for 1 drink, 1 appetizer and 2 entrees. Unfortunately, that is dining in the French Quarter.

Went today for the first time, even brought a friend. Diverse menu and coffee! My first mom break in a while i was looking forward to breakfast and coffee.   Well we got to the front, a man greeted us.... And then we stood there at the front... Waiting.. And waiting... No one spoke to us again.. All to busy i guess. There were two people eating breakfast inside and 1 car in the drive thru. 1 manager, 1 girl, and 2 other guys... Yet we stood there...finally i turned to my friend and said ill pay for breakfast elsewhere... Customers keep your business going, got better service in a crowded pj's coffee

Nice atmosphere and good drinks that could be stronger. Great price for happy hour. 2 stars because of the unsettling music and rude waitress. There was a long wait time and the waitresses are not attentive. 

Due to covid restrictions it is a requirement to order a food dish, unfortunately I was not inform until after I asked for the check. I have no problem getting a dish but the waitress was very rude about it and this is information that should be stated before the order.

I tried it for the first time today. I had heard the spaghetti was very good, and I was not disappointed. The sauce was delicious, and I got this huge meatball with it, about the size of a softball. I would definitely go back.

Place is outstanding from the house salad to the canoli and everything in between.  You will not be disappointed if you try anything BUT here are a few I like.

Large Cheese Pie well done
Chicken or Veal Parm or Franchisee 
Red sauce has excellent consistency and a tiny sweetness to it that is delicious. 

All these pizza joints with "REAL New York or New Jersey"  in the name seem to be REAL Florida.   Chefs is ACTUALLY really good tri state pizza.

Enjoy

Outstanding recipes made with fresh food. Thai tea wasn't sticky sweet. I ordered the Amazing Sauce entree and they were able to adjust the dish to my liking. Flavors are spot on. Highly recommend. They are on door dash.
Staff is rude when I asked price of an item, which does not have price tags.  Avoid this place if you have another choice.

Been coming here for a few years now and the food is always consistently very good, and never greasy. My all time favorite is their mandarin chicken and fried rice combo plate. So good! They are also locally owned and operated, so I love knowing when I eat here it supports small business.

We love this little cupcake shop!! They have so many different cupcake flavors to choose from. They have great weekly specials too. I still need to try their ice cream! It's a place you can go for fun with the kids for a sweet treat!

What the heck happened to The Pub?  Once one of my favorite places to go to grab a few drinks, some Bangers & Mash and of course Cheese Bullocks...now I walk past...food quality is way down, food is often under or over cooked.  Wait times for food has become a serious issue.  Always seem to be short staffed.  Its a shame, it was once a great place to go.  Kind of empty in there during lunch while other places are packed.  I can see why.
This is why I love pho! Great job pho bowl.  Did I just have the best pho in my life!? :)

I wanted to get off the beaten path from the tourist area so I tried this place.
Great food 
Great service
Nice clientele 
I had the Cali burger and beet salad.
Worth the Lyft ride here from the beach!
Gave, Tome, and Mac were all super friendly and fast at getting our order out. Despite it being busy! Love the food and customer service!

Been eating in and dining out here for 12 years.  Wonderful family owned and always consistently good food.  Tried others in the South Reno area and this restaurant provides the best portions for the price.  Eating in is always a great experience too.  Good service.

Bastion is too fun on a weekend night. The Wedgewood-Houston area never disappoints with cool bars surrounding the neighborhood like this one.

It's a very chill vibe, with a great atmosphere, drink menu, and space. Their drinks are hand-crafted with unique ingredients, so expect to shell out $10-$13 a cocktail, or opt for a cheaper beer. There's not too much space to mingle, though there are some couches and benches, and a few bar games.

On a warm night they'll often open up the garage door, opening up the space a bit more. Parking wise, they have a great large lot across the street that your DD can take advantage of!

GREAT SUSHI! I'd consider myself well exposed to many sushi joints in the philly area. The majority of the time, you pay much and get little; either in quality or quantity. At Mt. Fuji, you pay average prices for above average quality and quantity. The customer service is great and the chefs behind the sushi bar are very friendly and courteous. The sushi tastes and looks very very fresh. The one critique I would have is the stinginess in regards to charging for having your roll made with rice on the outside rather than on the inside. They also charge for the crunch(!) Linch specials are awesome as well. Will continue to come back!

Fantastic food! All food selections were perfect. Our party tried the egg roll appetizers, Zim Zari version of a Cobb salad, Mongolian, cheese burger and pork belly tacos. Props to our server Lauren! She was on point(((-:

Our regular go to take out place closed early. We had noticed City Pizza before and decided to give them a try. The person who answered the phone was patient and helpful even though we had been on hold. We arrived to their corner location with a  service window. We paid for our order while they were finishing our hot items. We mentioned that we couldn't find a menu on line and the staff member gave
 us three.
We were all very happy with our choices: hot chicken parm sandwich,  tuna hoagie and a pepperoni and cheese stromboli.  
Guess what our new go to spot will be. Try it!!

Sandwiches we had were good. Good flavor but they changed menu and have half the options which was disappointing. Vegan options almost non existence now. Again good but not sure worth finding parking downtown.

Amazing seasonal farm to table food! Great for dinner and amazing for Sunday Brunch.  Definitely make a reservation.  Also, be sure to get a cheese board; it's expensive but the cheesemonger (yes that's a real thing) will come over and tell you all about the cheeses and it's a whole experience.  This is absolutely one of my favorite restaurants in the city!

Drinks we ordered were horrible and barely any flavor, only think you can taste is powered flavor instead of actual fruits. What a rip off. Maybe try ordering their food, it might be better but I suggest avoid their drinks.
Don't use their online postmates ordering option. Over 40 minutes since we've ordered and 20 minutes since our order was "ready".
Courteous staff. Clean restaurant. Bathrooms are clean.  Food is consistently served and consistently tasted...ok. Ordering from drive through is also a fast option of ordering for takeout.

This may be a case of leaving well enough alone. Having been in S Jersey for over 35 years .we've had plenty Of choices of diners within a 4 mi radius of our home 5 or more if I had to stop& think. Even before the construction of the new overpass which partially lead to the end of this s Jersey gastronomic institution. I digress. 
Of the 5 or more diner to choose from Olga's was hardly ever considered legitimate place to eat.
Long before there was construction , Olga's was dirty and overall a place that I'd turn around and walk out because of the appearance. At the time the food was average. 
A big welcome back to Olga's the return of a s Jersey institution. It'snew it's sparkling it's smaller and the food was better than I recalled. 
My wife had an enormous portion of stuffed peppers w/mashed potatoes. In her own words aside from the large portion it was good but not outstanding.  I had a breakfast sandwich which was satisfactory 
So welcome back Olga's.. keep the place clean and I will be a customer for some time.
Great food. Service is good. Nice atmosphere inside. Outdoor area needs heaters for cooler weather. Menu has lots of variety, which is great for our picky kids & for the dieters in our group.

My wife used to go here in her younger days, and I have heard a lot about it. It is a joint. They are busy. The pizza is st louis thins style and it was great. Fresh out of the oven to our table. We had a couple of cold brews and a salad to go along with the pizza. 

I am sure we will visit again.

This Carrabbas location is one of our local "go-to" spots! They never fail to deliver consistent quality food, which is always delicious. Some of our favorites are the Mahi Wolfe, Chicken Bryan, and the Spiedino Di Mare! For dessert, you cannot beat the Cannolis! The service here is always spot on, and if you sit in the bar area, Carl will take great care of you. Even through all of the covid craziness, when they were mostly doing curbside and delivery, they managed to continue delivery top quality!
Amazing pizza with very interesting and delicious pizza of the month options. Family owned with great service, will definitely be returning!

I really enjoy honeygrow- the food is fresh and healthy. But there is a problem at this location. They need to hire more people. I ordered from the app, got a text that said it would take 15 min, and I ended up waiting outside for 45 minutes, wasting gas in my car. There aren't enough people working. Please hire someone else or send accurate text times for pickups.
Came here BEFORE closing and was turned away. Chairs on tables. This was my first and probably last.

Service- Good attentive service
Food- The food was really yummy, the noodles well cooked and shrimp decent size. Was sad the french onion soup was a beef broth but I understand that seems to be standard many places. My only reason for 4 stars was that when I take into consideration the price-portion-and taste I would have liked it to either fill me up a tad more or been a tad more memorable tasting. Regardless, all the food was very good and I'd reccommend everything in my pictures show . 
Atmosphere- I quite enjoyed sitting outside under the tent with all the heaters, it was cozy and toasty.

A fixture on Canal.  Stopped by for a beer and oysters. Service was very good. Oysters not huge but fresh and tasty. The grilled oysters were on par with most others. 

Enjoyed the experience and would return.

Amazing food!! Best Turkish food in St. Louis.  The lamb shank is the best I've ever had.  It has yogurt on it and the spicing is just perfect.  The falafel is great as well. The pastry filled with lamb and rice is unique and very tasty. The mixed grill is good, comparable to other places. 

Very kind service.
Excellent authentic Puertorrican home made food. Highly recommended! Love it! Everything is freshly made.

This is the best pizza in Nashville. Additionally, the servers and staff are incredibly nice. We had someone unscrew the red pepper which then poorer all over a slice and they comped is for the whole pizza! Unreal!
What a tucked in little nostalgic breakfast spot !!  And items on the  wall are for sale :) !

Average at best. Asked how the prime rib sandwich and burgers were and was encouraged to go with a steak. I have always found sandwiches and burgers are really good at "mid level" steakhouses. This is no Morton's or Fleming's. This is Outback. As a matter of fact should have gone to Outback instead.

Horrible service, horrible place and horrible food. If I could give 0 stars I would. Obviously management doesn't know how to do their job. Go ahead and go to this place if you want to sit with your children in lobby and hear a crazy lady screaming off the top of her lungs in back while the employees pretend to not hear her . Unprofessionalism Probably has something to do with why the burgers are burnt and fries are always cold. NO ONE should go here unless you want a really horrible experience. Not somewhere I'll be taking my kids again

I'd love to give this place 5 stars but the quality of food is inconsistent.  Excellent atmosphere with live music several times a week.  Great beer selection with reasonable prices for the beer.  Buck a shuck on Wednesday's is an amazing deal and they have so many varieties of oysters.  During covid they made great outdoor seating and this place has become our once-a-week (or more) getaway.

Nachos are huge. Chicken jerk wrap and jambalaya are excellent.  Seafood is also very good.  Skip the steak and hope you get a good Caesar salad (50% chance).

So after spending 42.00 for 4 pastries and a latte, I decided to order my annual apricot Kringle that I gift a friend every birthday. The past few years it hasn't been ready when I go to pick it up, so decided I'd preorder it a week early since I was there. I kindly asked the young man working the counter if it was a good time or if I should call later. He was interrupted by the daughter of the owner and she said I'll be right with you. She then came over and asked what kind of cake I want. When I told her, she loudly exclaimed that's not a cake! That's a pastry!!! And we have them all the time!! When I paused to think I might be confused she VERY RUDELY said bye bye, bye bye, bye bye.. all the while I'm standing next to a sign advertising her "Hugge" breakfast... which is the danish way of being cozy, comfortable, and at peace. This lady and this place are anything but that! I'll never step foot in there again, there are too many merchants struggling to survive to give my business to rude people. I'd rather drive to Solvang and I will from now on for my apricot Kringle!!!
Amazing food, drinks and staff! So fresh! I recommend the Taco Trio and classic margs!
Best coffee, breakfast food, and service in Clearwater!  We loved everything! Highly recommend especially for coffee or lattes! Staff was very friendly and helpful!
Good service, but the pizza was just okay. Sauce and crust good, also great reheated. Great basic pizza.

Went there on a spur of the moment whim since I was walking around Germantown and 312 was too busy. I sat down and the first bartender ignored me, another bartender took my order pretty quickly though. After ordering and getting my beer I was asked for my card and told they have an eight dollar minimum, so I should check out a menu. I ended up ordering the pulled pork sandwich. It was dry and stale. All in all I'll probably give it one more shot, but not until I've tried the much more popping von Elrods.

This place is absolutely fantastic. Great food, great drink selection and fair prices. The atmosphere is nice and the staff is friendly as are the owners who routinely talk to customers and thank them for their patronage. Highly recommend this bar to anyone looking to check out smaller spots in Manayunk off the beaten path of Main Street. Make sure you ask for Chris behind the bar...he'll take care of ya!

Great friend chicken and shrimp. The sides were all wonderful, especially the hush puppies
Service was great. We had a really sweet male server. 
I would definitely go back!

If you are a BBQ fan and in Nashville, this place is a must. Call ahead to make sure they aren't out. Good news is this location is less likely to sell out than the downtown location. We had the ribs - dry and wet half-half. The ribs were very good but a tad dry/chewy in some bites. The smoked wings were a nice surprise and excellent - a must try. Also could not get enough of the corn hoecake. Overall I liked the chill vibe, low prices and amazing food.
The atmosphere is really cute and the employees are friendly but the coffee tasted old and bitter :( good place to stop in and warm up during winter in the city though!!!
Marginal food, marginal drinks - way overpriced. Had the grouper tacos, they were dry and no flavor. Skinny margaritas I had soda water taste, we added lime to it but it still tasted like soda water

I really like this restaurant.  Service is great and food is prepared correctly.  I just wish they would offer some other fish besides mahiahibon the sandwich. They used to and it was wonderful.  Used to go alot more when they had a gulf fish sandwich 
 We are on New Orleans fish is easy
 Ease consider a second choice 
Thank you

I enjoy the food but the fact that the dining rooms are closed for even take out is asinine. If it's a COVID thing then I don't think they've looked at the CDC facts showing that I have more of a chance of dying from a vending machine falling on me and killing me so I have to assume Del Taco is protecting me from their ice machines killing me. With Reno growing so much, a lot of people that want something quick to eat would like Del Taco so they can go back to work to help that growth. That also means service trucks and tractor trailers and many other vehicles don't fit in the drive through. Also, someone today may or may not have tore some stucco off the building because they were tired of the dining room being closed so they took their service truck that doesn't fit through it anyways.

Burgers and Potatoes were excellent! I was confused at first when I walked in, just a large crowed around the bar but no host stand. I asked a few patrons if we were in line and they had all been checked in said someone comes around every now and then. I finally was able to find the hostess and got a seat within 30 min for 2. 

Everything was great, I'd just recommend better seating instructions.

Tacos are reasonably priced 2 for $5.95 comes with tomato & guacamole & of course the norm onion cilantro...Burritos are legit...churros pretty fresh.....they don't have long wait times people are impatient and don't think (if there are 3 people in front of you then 15min is not long, they are COOKING your food!

When we moved to Philly, this is where the locals all told us to go. They aren't wrong! Make sure you have cash and do some research ahead of time to know what you want, it's always busy. The food is piping hot and drool worthy, absolutely worth the wait!

Coming from bay area (where we have a lot of good Indian food places) I can say this place lives up to my expectation of good, or rather great Indian food. Fabulous tasty food, great variety, right from south Indian to North India as well as some Indo Chinese options. The dosa's are just perfect. I have been to quite a few places serving dosa in California but this place made the best Mysore Masala Dosa. The chicken tikka masala curry was finger licking good. Was totally worth it.

So we came back after a year. Food was still excellent. Still love the ambience, but it was less crowded and the service was better (not that the service was bad last time). We had the duck, the swordfish, and the trout. All were excellent. The duck breast was particularly distinct in the way it was prepared (had a steak like quality to it).

Really, while this place wasn't empty, I'm surprised it wasn't difficult to get a table. It may become one of our favorite Olde City neighborhood gems.

Went with a party of 6 waited about 10 mins, not bad at all. I hadn't been there in some years and was seated on the newer side I guess that look like we're eating at Piccadilly's the waiter was excellent and the food was delicious. The parking can be a pain because it's very limited watch out for the tow away signs. I'll definitely be visiting again!!
Thank you Texas Roadhouse for everything you're doing right now we do appreciate you guys keep up the good work

We are SO happy to be back out and eating at our favorite restaurants that we have missed dearly the last couple months. Taxman is such a great place to not only enjoy a delicious dinner but their beer/drank menu is out of this world! Everything I have ever gotten to eat at Taxman is so flavorful. On Saturday night we split the Wings and a regular size  Frites as we had a late lunch. The wings were coated in a honey chipotle sauce. It reminded me of Chili's Honey Chipotle only BETTER and with a perfect amount of heat. The Frites were phenomenal as always. Frites is a fancy word for fries in case you didn't know, as I didn't the first time I dined with Taxman years ago. They are hand cut, fried, then double pan fried. These Frites will seriously leave you wanting more. The menu at Taxman is rotating which can sometimes cause you to be bummed out. But every food item we have tried in our years of visiting their Bargersville location has never disappointed us! 

For my drink I opted for a mix drink on Saturday instead of their beer. I went with the Paloma Rita, actually drank 3 of them, as a girlfriend had suggested it weeks ago and it had great flavor as well!! They always have such an extensive list of beers they brew. Literally, any beer drinker can find something they like.
Place is a craphole.. Inside and out absolutely nasty.. It's like they drain the greese into their driveway.

While working near the SB area I wanted to try something different from what I normally would eat such as Mexican, American, Asian, or Italian food.  I stepped out of my comfort zone and went for some Caribbean food.  Boy, am I happy with the choice that I made. The food was absolutely delicious! 
I went during the pandemic so dining was outdoors which I didn't mind at all. I had to wait for about 25 mins for a table but I didn't mind. The weather was nice and warm in the early evening. In fact, while waiting for my table I was jamming to the one man band musician that plays the steel drums beautifully and has a great voice too. I finally was seated and my waiter Jockco was more than gracious and accommodating. He took my order and brought my wine and water out Immediately. The Jerk Chicken I ordered took about 25-30 mins. Typically, I'd be frustrated by the long wait, but do to COVID-19 I understand that things are moving at a much slower pace, so I just patiently waited.
When my food finally arrived it smelled delicious. The presentation looked like a magazine ad. When I took my first bite of my meal I knew I had made the right choice on this restaurant, and know that I will come back on future visits to SB. The portions are very proper. You can save some for later if you wish. 
Overall, I had a wonderful experience. The staff was great, and I believe the owner came out to greet the patrons. A big thumbs up to this restaurant. I'm glad that I made the best choice.
Pho is PHOnaminal. I'm literally signed up for Yelp just to right the review because i am in shock it's only a 3.5 on google. I've been having pho for years and this is top 3

Came here for lunch after outdoor seating opened in Yellow Phase after COVID lockdown. Servers and staff were super attending in explaining now things would work in our post COVID world.

Loved their garlic black pepper wings. You squeeze lime over it and love it all the more better. The glazed bacon lollies were a good. But the amount you get for the price, not my my favorite thing. 

Their homemade pasta is definitely home made. I had the roasted mushroom pappardelle amaretto cream was just enough sauce for a creamy sauce. My friend got the Aged NY Strip steak ordered medium rare, and come out medium rare. But, for a dry aged it was okay, nothing special tasted like a normal strip steak rather than a dry aged. What I would never order again is the Chinese Takeout Spare Ribs. They came out and were super salty, like I went straight to take a huge gulp of water salty. I let the server know, he told the manager, and the manager checked with the chef. I was told that the recipe was followed properly, it maybe the soy sauce glazed that made it salty and the manager offered to have it remade with the glaze on the side so we could dip the ribs in to get the amount of sauce we wanted. The ribs came out both my friend and I tried a piece without any sauce and my God it was just as salty. Definitely the seasoning of the meat before they cook it. The sauce being a little sweet actually helped. Only bright side of this dish was that the ribs were fall of the bone soft and the side of f

This place deserves more than 3.5 stars. My wife and I eat here regularly. The food is delicious, atmosphere warm, prices very reasonable. We get consistently have good experiences here and comment to each other how good the food was.

Fun place for drinks and people watching. I might give this place one more shot at their dinner menu but it's unlikely. We were unimpressed with the chicken piccata and the antipasto di formaggi was so sadddd. I could not believe that they charge $20 for a cheese board that looked like an Aldi special. I love Aldi by the way. There were 4 grapes, that was all of the fruit on the board, 8 plain crackers, 4 cheeses sliced and broken up like pieces of broken glass and 2 meats a ham and a salami. Boring and sorry  Napoli please check out the boards at Defiance Ridge Winery for comparison, those are boards for $19-$23. This restaurant is located in a special location I hope they improve the food quality so St. Louis can enjoy both location and quality.

Was very good, they accommodated my shellfish allergy. They had a lot of appetizers with shellfish only (wanted dumplings  but on had shrimp  ones. My filet was amazing. They had different sauces then most hibachi ( no yummy yummy sauce) which is one of the main reasons o go to hibachi. Other sauces were ok but so super salty I know I'll be up all night drinking water.  My green apple  martini was perfection. Service good.  Please get on board and get some yummy yummy sauce

We stopped here in search of some yummy food and we found it. We ordered 2 bean burros, nachos, and 2 Sunday Specials, which were sweet carnitas enchiladas. I loved the enchiladas! So good!! Everyone enjoyed the food. The nachos had steak and the steak was very good as well. It's unfortunately on the other side of town from us, but we will be back!

Man am I glad I popped in here. Was staying at the JW Marriott just across the street and was looking for a good quick lunch. I couldn't decide what I wanted so the dude at the counter told me to try the Mufaletta... it did not disappoint! I got the half order and it was huge! Good spot, good food!

This is my first ever Yelp review and I'm leaving it because that's just how much I love Christie's!!! Best breakfast sandwich in the city (Mike's Special), great customer service, I want to try their lunch food but can't stop eating the breakfast sandwich - maybe some day. Strongly recommend!!

This is not your usual clayton find. If you're looking for something more relaxed, a friendly staff that isn't too hard on the wallet, this is your place. Food is outstanding. The chicken wings are my go to and you can't go wrong with a mini fielder or the mini chicken fielders. Christine, the day bartender is by far my favorite girl to visit! Outstanding service.

This is one of the best and most authentic Caribbean restaurants I've had in central Florida. All the food was superb and healthy. The restaurant itself is very clean and everything is brand new. Staff was super friendly as well and I can't wait to come back!

I have mixed emotions about this review. I visited Sabrina's yesterday and had a horrible experience. Originally Sabrina's was one of my favorite brunch restaurants in the Philly area. However I blame the pandemic for such a not so great experience yesterday. We were excited that Sabrina's was doing outdoor seating. So we called and asked to be put on a waitlist and we were told that there's no wait list. When we arrived we requested outdoor seating. They told us we would be seated soon at a nearby table. I asked would they like my name for a waitlist. And Again they mentioned there is no waitlist. And they promised us a seat at a particular nearby table. Five minutes later the other host proceeded to seat another family at the table that was promised to me. When I asked her about it she told me that they are on the waitlist and I am not. I told her that I was told that there is no waitlist. She was rude and told me that she could add me to the waitlist now but I cannot be seated for a while. Finally we were seated and ordered our food. When the food came out the order was incorrect. In addition my food was placed in Styrofoam. I was mortified. I asked if they could make it again and not put it in Styrofoam because I am allergic to Styrofoam chemicals. They made my meal again and put the hot food in plastic, which was awful. The experience was getting worse and worse by minute. The whole visit was such a frustration. And I had to wait so long for my food. I wish I would've ch
Wonderful experience per usual! I never leave disappointed and the quality of the food always ceases to amaze me with each visit.

4pm on a Sunday. The place was maybe half full.
Waited 10 mins to get sat
Waited 10 mins to get a waitress once we were sat
Waited 10 mins to get drink.
Waited 44 mins to get food after we ordered.
Well done cheeseburger was pink. 

We won't be back.
great family style breakfast place.  my favorite there is eggs benedict with double bacon, really filling and delicious.  service is attentive and polite, food comes quick and coffee refills also.

This place hit the spot! When you want a cheese steak but you're also craving Indian spices. This is your best bet. I would have never thought to put the two together but this place did it and I love them for it. 

It looks like your basic pizza place just a little bigger. Right when you walk in on the right side are all the 'spicy' options. I got two spicy chicken cheese steaks and one spicy beef steak. I must admit I enjoyed the Spicy Chicken Cheesesteak so much more. I also got spicy fries and the spicy garlic bread. All good and filling. Even my picky South Indian parents loved it! 

I can't wait to go back again!

I can honestly say that I was disappointed. The staff was very friendly as well as the security outside, it's the only reason I give it 3 stars. The food was overrated and missing southern flavor. The chicken was flavorful but seems like the haven't changed the grease s it was really dark, the butter beans and red beans were vegan so they we're missing the smoked flavor that you would get when cooked smoked meats. The menu was very limited which was a surprise to us, overall not a place I would recommend.

Nice find. Great food. Authentic red sauce plus amazing salad. Highly recommend.
Would visit again.

After dinner we were gonna got to the Sazerac as we enjoyed it there the night before, but they were full, so we came here as they were pretty empty.  We were greeted & seated instantly near the bar as we had just wanted to get some drinks. 

Our waitress was very nice & mentioned to me that they had just changed up their drink menu & the drink I had selected has not been a hit among customers & she wouldn't want us to waste our money on something that wasn't good.  She asked me what type of drinks I liked to which I said sweet & she suggested a few of the popular ones.  I don't remember the name of the drink, but the fact that she said it tasted like key lime pie, I was sold.  We didn't wait too long to get our drinks, the bf got a vodka lime & then mine came with the foam on top.  Took a sip & she was right! It wasn't too sweet which was great, even the bf enjoyed it.  Not sure what was in it, but I would definitely order that again. 

Thank you to our waitress for making those suggestions, I wish I remembered her name!
My husband and I tried it for dinner tonight and loved it! Our waitress Tammy was great and reccomend beef skewers and sliders and man they didn't disappoint!! We will be back!!

Omg. We had such a great time -- on a Monday evening, no less! The food was great (I loved the eggplant veggie entree!) and the music -- open mike -- was impressive! Congrats to David Allee for bring recognized as one of the top 100 jazz clubs in the world! Well deserved!

This is what farm to table is all about! Every time my husband and I have come here the food is prepared to order and I have never had something I didn't like. The homemade biscuits are a must and the brunch is very good also. It's kind of neat that you can see the chefs preparing your food right from where you are seated. They take take-out orders also!

INCREDIBLE Birthday Dinner ! From the greeting to the sweets everything was delicious. My Husband and I have wanted to try the Lake House for dinner for a Special occasion for years. This restaurant is worth a drive no matter how far. The views of the lake from both inside and outside dining are spacious and stunning.  The varieties of drinks, beer and wine are many. The appetizer of fried Calamari for those who enjoy it lightly battered and tender was done perfectly. The seafood soup and creamy carrot soup also full of flavor.  Our Entrees of Angus filets with crabmeat , asparagus and roasted potatoes were layered and just heavenly. Waitstaff was attentive and helpful. Sweet s were of a good portion and selection. We took our Italian Lemon cake with cream and key lime cheesecake home. No regrets We will return.
Great restaurant managed well during COVID!  Special thanks to Jason for doing such a great job!  Enjoyed our meal and time there.  Well definitely be coming back!

Tiny spot in South Philly with a changing menu that emphasizes local ingredients. It is quite loud, so you might be better off with just two people and maybe not for a first date. Really loved the fresh pasta and desserts in particular.

Here now Server 67 (tattooed blond) took almost 10 minutes on back deck bar to even offer a drink.  When I mentioned such POOR Attitude!
Sunday evening not even busy.
UNSATISFACTORY.
Yet she was quick to pick up her tip!!!

Absolutely love this place, the food is amazing and it looks all the people work there are extremely super nice and polite. 
Definitely recommend to visit if you are close by
The fish was AMAZING. We had sashimi and Nigiri-zushi, and it was fantastic. Especially considering this is Idaho. If you are looking for amazingly fresh fish, this is it.

Any pizza joint that sells wings without ranch included is a red flag. Not because it's owed, but most places aren't reluctant to give some sauce. While that doesn't ruin a pizza place, the standoffish service for no real reason was an added disappointment. Overpriced, wings are bad, and a good opportunity to find a different pizza place worth your money. No one deserves bad pizza, go elsewhere.

I stopped by Zizzo's this morning for a cup of coffee and the experience exceeded my expectations. The gentleman who greeted me at the window was friendly and engaging and even offered my dog a treat! He also called me by my name (since he noticed it on my company car). This attention to detail to make an experience more personal is what customer service is all about. I was pleasantly surprised and I will definitely think of Zizzo's when I need a coffee or a ham & cheese croissant out in Goleta.
Ugly crab, Castleton, just opened wk ago. Went tonite. Very very tasty. Good service, very reasonable prices. Offering 10% off currently. Diffently recommend!
Looks just like a food Court setting.  Hot food on a buffet line, with someone serving you.  Several different options including some Asian inspired things.  Not what I was personally looking for.

So I go in to the Wawa to get a couple of Sizli's and some altoids the bill was a little bit more than I thought, I looked at the price for them and I was charged $2.59 when the price says $1.19. I tell the cashier no problem (rushing to work) so I had no time to argue, but I do tell him to change the price because someone may lose it.
So when I go back there a couple days later what do I see the same incorrect price.

Two stars EARNED.

Giiirl. We just got avocado toast and a BLT from this place through Postmates and it was all a waste of money. There was barely any avocado on the bread, only a thin spread in the middle and it did not touch the crusts at all. First bite was only bread, sprouts and seasoning. And they literally just dumped the saltiest seasoning right in the middle of the huge mound of sprouts. SO much seasoning. Too salty. 
The BLT supposedly has avocado on it but does it really?

Went here for dinner last night based on a recommendation from some Indian friends. We had the Indo-Chinese entrees and a spicy chicken appetizer. This is authentic Indian cuisine so the food is very spicy... but oh sooooo good!!! The spicy chicken appetizer had me reaching for my mango lassi after every bite, but I couldn't stop eating it. We will definitely be back. we love Indian cuisine!

I'm so sad. I placed an order through Yelp for pickup to support this business during this hard time. I received notifications that the order was both received and ready for pickup. I get here and the place is closed, locked and no one is answering the phones. My card was still charged. I had to call Yelp support to get a refund. I even checked social media pages and website for any updates and there weren't any.

Wasted gas. Wasted time.

When we come up for hot August nights we always come here and sit at the bar to enjoy a salad and a pan roast. This time was no different. We had a great waitress - her name was Grace. Very professional and accommodating!  We shared a shrimp and Pan roast - it was so good with the warm bread and butter. Grace even gave us two smaller bowls  so we can share. The scallops and shrimp were cooked perfected. So tender!  And I just continuously dip my bread into The pan roast sauce!  So yummy!

I was however disappointed in my side salad.  I'm not a fan of iceberg lettuce but that's what I got. Last year it was spring mix and why shouldn't this year be any
Different?   not offering salad again if it's iceberg lettuce.

Taking advantage of being in downtown STL this was an easy choice since I have wanted to try Shake Shack. My wife and I created our own cheeseburger and was not disappointed. Great flavor, juicy, and a decent size. 

We also order fries, and 1/2 lemonade and 1/2 tea. Love the Crinkle Cut fries, which were cooked just right.  The "Arnold Palmer" was also good. 

Before we left I bought a chocolate shake to go. Very good, but kind of small for almost $6. Since we don't get downtown much it will be a while before we return. However, we will go back at some point. To me this is a treat type restaurant since it is a little pricey in my opinion. 

Again, the food was excellent and the staff very nice.

Hands down the best Mexican restaurant in Indy. Reasonably priced, huge portions, and the food is fantastic. Haven't had a bad meal yet. That's saying a lot since I've been coming at least once a week since they opened a couple years ago. The servers are always friendly and attentive. You won't be disappointed.
Great service my sushi burrito was amazing. I have been to this place before but now it looks as if they have increased their selection. I can't wait to try some of the others!
I ordered the ribeye and it was honestly the best Ive ever had. Definitely coming back, excellent service and the food was amazing. My new favorite steakhouse!!

First time dining at Oliver's,  for all of us.
We sat on the dining room, which was comfortable.  I don't think I'd like to eat at one of the tables in the storefront windows at the  front of the restaurant,  but that's just my preference.  It's a BYOB and the busperson brought us water and wine glasses.  They were a bit busy so we had to wait for menus and our server to tell us the specials, but no problem, we were happy to have a chance to talk and catch up.  One of the specials offered was Jersey corn, prepared in about 5 different ways.  Two of our party ordered as a side dish.  It looked delicious, they agreed.  I had the  steak fritte, done medium rare, cooked just the way I like it with some pink in the middle.  It came with truffle fries and arugula salad
Delicious. It was 12oz. Steak and I took half of it home. I'm going to have to go back for the crab cake croissant as that looked very interesting.  Friends had the pork shank,  and burgers - many varieties available.  Unfortunately we were too full for dessert. 
Definitely a good choice when you're in Bordentown.

Been wanting to try Revery since they opened and today was finally the day!  I was very pleased.  Our waitress was quite personable and came by an adequate number of times.  My friend and I both ordered the Chicken Salad Croissant and we replaced our chips with the Rev Salad which was delicious!  And just the perfect amount of dressing!  Would definitely recommend!

Good bbq at a reasonable price. Dont miss the bbq pork steak, it's not on the menu. I don't really care of the fried corn, so tried the sweet corn. Okra is good and the mac n cheese is not too shabby. Love the rub on the ribs, no sauce needed. This is my third time here and first time the Carolina mustard sauce was spot on. The second time it was too spicy. This time it's more like the first. So, there might be a little inconsistency on the sauce batches, but when it is made in house, that is to be expected once in a while. This place is super busy on Saturday nights, so order takeout through yelp.

Moccia's has been a staple in my family for over 15 years. I've had just about everything on the menu, and pizza every Friday night for most of my life. You can't go wrong with anything you choose but I especially love the garlic bread cheesesteaks. I'm a cheesesteak connoisseur and Moccia's beats out any of philly's best, without a doubt. There aren't too many options in this area, so having a place like Moccia's train stop that delivers consistently excellent food is a really blessing. I appreciate the Moccia family and there dedication to serving the community, and wish them much luck and success for the years to come! (Not that they will need it)
We've been to the Turning Point twice- both times we have had an awesome experience. The breakfast options are unique and everything we have tried is delicious.

My favorite of the many Greek restaurants on the docks.  Their salads are the freshest and best tasting of any I've ever had.  And I have never had a dish there that didn't leave me wanting to go back and have it again.  I've taken locals there and guests from out of town.  Everyone raves about the food and service.  and they have their own parking!

Good food, great prices, large selection.  Soups, salads, sandwiches, chips and a variety of sides to choose from.  My daughter choose the 'Choose 2 deal with Garden Fresh Turkey and the broccoli cheddar soup. Which the bread was extra soft and fresh and the soup was very tasty and a nice amount that she had enough to take home to for later.  My wife had the Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap and a side of potato salad was extra fresh.  I ordered the Ultimate Nacho and the sweet tea.  The nacho was dressed with more than enough toppings.  Only order the nachos if you are planning on sharing.  I could only manage to eat about a ¼ of it. The menu has a balance option to the point where anyone can find something to eat at this location. 

The customer service was outstanding at this location on this visit with the staff walking around checking to make sure all orders were correct and that the seating area was clean.  100% improvement from the last tie I eat at this location.
Best place in town! Fast service, great atmosphere and practices safe social distancing business putting plexiglass in between the tables. Not to mention great enchiladas and margaritas!

My friend and I stopped in for breakfast this am  Sunday ,got seated within 20 minutes which was fine, the hostess the older lady Is always so rude its unbelievable for 1, throws the menus down on the table then just walks off. For 2 our server was awful, younger girl with tattoos her name was Brenda or Breann . Seemed to be to busy goofing around then taking care of her tables. Sad because we love this place and we have never had bad service here . Our food was just ok , wasnt warm at all. We was overall very disappointed today. We will try again but we will ask for one of the girls we know that have been there a while

This is not a five star hotel, people. The food is good, the casino is okay, and the rooms are fine. 

You can't expect to be treated like a king, if you're paying for a commoner's room. It is what it is. It's  inexpensive, and it's close to all the other casinos. So freakin relax!

Oh my goodness this place is amazing.   A serious party in my mouth.   The crab enchiladas "Enchiladas Cabo Azul" were "melt in your mouth good!"  The salad, the rice, the chips and 3 salsas were perfection.   The appetizer, Queso Fundido will blow your mind.    Can't wait to eat here again.      Oh wait, forgot to mention my margarita fresa.    Yum yum yum!   Muy delicioso  and I'm one picky Mexican.

So it's my brother's house-warming party and I'm in town to hang out. Sis-in-law tells me they've placed an order that needs to be picked up so I volunteered.  She gives me direction to a place called I Love Salad, and I'm thinking what the hell did they order, a family-style garbage salad?  So I walk in the store and *clearly* the owners are Korean. (I can usually tell.. ;-)  Turns out the order was a bumch of kimbop rolls.

Unnecessary intro aside.. the rolls were acrually pretty damed good.  Kimbops, similar to something like futomaki (fat rolls) is not a luxurious food item.  It's equivalent of curbside hotdog stands you stop by on your walk back from school.  In the old days they were literally just that.  Auntie would roll up hundred-thirty-five rolls in the morning, wrap them in aluminum foil and sell them off to 3rd graders walking home after school at 70 cents a pop.  I guess where I'm getting at is that there's definitely a nostalgia-factor when it comes to it.  Don't give me wrong.  There'a a lot that could go wrong with this simple food that consist of rolled up rice with buncha veggies and protein.  It could be bland because rice wasn't seasoned correctly.  It could of already gone bad by the time you eat it because of the nature of mixing different ingredients together.  Way they're rolled also helps one's appetite.  Nobody wants to eat an exploded roll.  (It actually happens..)

Expert kimboppers have mastered their arts throughout time though.  It's a perfect

Ordered delivery from this restaurant-first time eating here. Everything was packaged beautifully and the portions are large! I had the noodle soup with chicken and it was delicious. Full of fresh veggies and chicken and the broth was very flavorful. They put the noodles in a separate container which helped them stay firm and not mushy. My husband had the sesame chicken and my son had the broccoli beef-both said they were great. Definitely will be ordering more selections in the future because they have a huge menu with a lot of my favorites!

The atmosphere is unbelievable!!! If you are looking for a fun night, family night, or even a  romantic night - this is the place to be. They have multiple bon fire pits to hang out at and have a drink, and multiple tables with heaters surrounding. My girlfriend and I sat outside and we loved it. The wait staff was incredibly friendly and COVID aware. We each ordered a margarita - I ordered the deseo del sol and my girlfriend ordered the blackrose margarita. The deseo del sol was blood orange flavored and was sweet but not overly sweet. The blackrose had a heavy rosemary flavor, and my girlfriend loved it. For food we ordered the short rib tacos and grouper quesadilla. The grouper quesadilla was very cheesy and delicious and the Crema that came with it was incredible. The short rib tacos were pretty good - they reminded me of the Barbacoa tacos at chipotle but they had a very good flavor. Overall I would come to this place more so for the atmosphere but the food was also very good.

The first visit was much better.  However, checkout my review under the burger we ordered medium rare.   It was well done & server agreed and did nothing.  She agreed it looked awful.  We paid tipped 20%, but we will not be back.  Disappointed since we live in neighborhood and great spot for dinner with friends.  We would only return if pressured by neighbors for a beer... beer only.

This restaurant wasn't super crowded when we arrived for a late lunch so it was perfect. I'm guessing with how flavorful and genuine the food is this place is probably packed in the evening. 
The service was good, attentive and seemed to care if we liked the food. 
I look forward to sitting outside in front this summer with a refreshing beverage.

Thanks to Yelp, I found this fantastic location. My friends arrived mid-morning from the airport and wanted something local and fulfilling and this checked off all boxes. We were greeted right away and were seated and served water promptly. We were certainly entertained by the menu names, but some decided to play it safe. Well, I was incredibly impressed with the Sweet Taboo French toast and sausage. My friends enjoyed their omelets as well. Those that kept to some traditional menu items like eggs & toast still were able to appreciate the food and service. I am glad once again that this place turned up on my list. Definitely would recommend.

Went there a couple weeks ago. Food was good and priced right. Atmosphere very lacking  but would recommend it over the other Mexican restaurants in this town that are all cookie cutter, this one is a little unique

Went for taco Tuesday! With heavy rain, they shifted everyone inside and made it work. We had a great waitress, Allie I think. Tacos were fabulous and guac was one of the best I've had! The staff was executing all necessary safety measures and everything was done really well. Will be returning!

Decent reviews from google and the fact that it was close after we hiked Tanque Verde was why we ended up here for some good authentic Mexican food - being a New England Native - I was anxious to taste authentic .  I had hoped that the food would look better than photos of the food in the menu.   But sadly, no.   Shredded lettuce covered the main entree and so it was hard to confirm if I got what I ordered.   Still, I was hoping it would taste amazing  so I dug in only to find that both the enchilada and Chile relleno were cold.   So, not made to order - obviously prepared ahead of time and pulled from the freezer or fridge and barely  warmed up. The refried beans and rice were hot but pretty bland.  I gave  one star because the woman who took our order was friendly and the food came out fast.  I wouldn't consider going back.
Soooo good! And.... they take food allergies seriously! I have celiac and they made the BEST gluten free fried rice EVER!

Ugh. I'm very forgiving when it comes to food because I'm so easy to please although my two ex-husbands would likely disagree. Anyway, ever since moving to East Nashville I have been in search of the perfect, authentic quesadilla. You know, the kind made with real Mexican cheese that you can stretch for miles. Some friends of mine told me to try Rosepepper so I did. I ordered the quesadilla for delivery. I understand these are trying times and that food can cool off by the time it gets to my house but the quesadilla was hands down the worst I've ever had. Maybe I got spoiled living in Chicago and having access to authentic and delicious Mexican food but Rosepepper quesadilla was made with cheese that was obviously the finely shredded blend you get in the grocery store and to make it even worse, they didn't cook it long enough to melt the cheese. That and the taste, or lack thereof, is how I immediately knew they didn't use authentic Mexican cheese. It was an ungrilled and cold tortilla with tiny chunks of chicken and the American version of Mexican blended cheese you get in the grocery store lightly sprinkled on top. After I told my friends who recommended Rosepepper, every single one of them told me they didn't recommend it for the food, because it's not very good, but for the margaritas. If you're looking for good, authentic Mexican food, avoid this place at all cost. If you want great drinks with friends and some chips and salsa then go for it.

Went here for dinner and the wait time was about an hour and a half. We were able to join the virtual wait list which is a 10/10 for me. Drink selection is large and drinks range from $7-10. Got the grouper sandwich with fries, it was a bit fishy so I'm taking one star off. However, the service was excellent, we sat at the bar.

I will NEVER COME BACK TO THIS LOCATION. How you you have 13 people on shift and only 5 people being productive!? The cooks in the back and cashier are literally the only ones working. EVERYONE ELSE IS STANDING AROUND DOING NOTHING!

Excellent Mexican food!  The service is friendly, and the delivery service folks are friendly, too.  Great burritos.  Love the tacos and the meat basket salad.  They have interesting looking seafood options but I haven't tried them yet.  Highly recommend Three Brothers if you're looking for tasty tacos and burritos.
The food was good! I had the gnocchi, and my husband had the salmon. The ambiance was nice too. Very pretty restaurant.
Great Pizza!  Chicago style, but tone's down the "Chicago Style's" "pizza-casserole" characteristic, which to me, is an improvement.  Other's may think differently

We tried Water Oak for the first time last night. We were pleasantly surprised. My wife and I are still not eating in restaurants yet but have been ordering delivery and to go food. I say on the Water Oak menu that meal kits were being offered, the price seemed right so we ordered the seafood trio. The meal was ready in under 15 minutes. It came out in a aluminum tray with the salad in a separate container. 
I got it home opened it up and it smelled great. More than enough food for the two of us. The meal was cooked to perfection. We are definitely gonna try the other meal kits soon.

Chocolate chip cookie is delicious. The macadamia white chocolate was a bit too sweet for my liking. The Italian sandwich was just okay, I wish the bread was more fresh. The young blond woman at the counter was very sweet and helpful.
First time visit for lunch. Food and service excellent with great explanation about the food. Will be back!

I came in here for a quick breakfast with a co-worker since the hotel breakfast look like... well not edible.  

I came in ordered a bacon/egg/cheese bagel and a coffee.  The bagel was very good and fresh tasting.  The bacon was a little thin and over cooked for my tastes, but I didn't ask for the bacon to be done less so how can I complain about that?

The coffee was very good, and my co-worker enjoyed his bagel with cream cheese as well.

I would recommend coming here and the service was quick and very freindly.

Words can't start to describe how much I love this place. Sushi Ai Is the best deal you can get in town. I honestly feel like for the value, quantity and quality of food there's no better deal! 

My favorite thing to get is the honey roll, the gyozas are delicious, and the rest of the sushi is great! 

The only thing that I honestly don't like about this place is that they use a lot of cucumbers on their sushi. I'm not a huge fan of that but it won't stop me from continuously coming back.

Honestly anyone who gives Five Guys less than 5 stars either has 0 tastebuds or found a piece of their own hair in their food. Listen people if you haven't tried Five Guys yet, you're missing out on a key part of life. Not only are their burgers amazing, everything on their burgers taste so fresh. It is amazing. Did I say that already? (Take the hint). AND THAT'S NOT EVEN THE BEST PART!!! Five Guys blesses your life with extra fries. I have never gone to FG and not had them fill up my cup of fries, and then pour the rest of the basket in my bag. I like to imagine them saying "she needs some extra potatoes in her life" and then proceeding to dump the entire basket. This is one place I will never debate on going. So if your debating on trying it, don't. This is not one of those places.

Seemed like it was the only spot on the Ave that was open tonight (due to the snow).  Picked up some "nachos" (it was 75%beans and 15% chips), enchiladas and tacos (both dry and bland). Service and quality have gone downhill over the years. Very Unfortunate.
Wonderful place great food wide menu a must if your in green hills :) :) one of the best please give santo a chance

I thought I'd give this poke spot a shot, but the place didn't feel all too clean. Also, the smell of fish starting to turn bad was obvious. I was so turned off that I literally couldn't get past a couple bites and had to throw out my meal :( not happy about it

EEEEK! From the service to the facility to the wait time, this TG was the worst TG experience we've ever had.

Firstly, I know this sounds weird but the steps to get to top golf are huge. I'm sure you can ask for something wheel chair accessible but you'd have to send someone up to the top to get the elevator, if they even have one.

Reservations were sold out online so we called ahead. They don't take reservations over the phone...we drove all the way there on a Sunday, didn't think the wait was going to be too long....it was a two hour wait!!!! WE WERE SHOCKED!!! 

What was even more shocking was the careless attitudes of the employees. They had no idea what was going on and it was obvious. I asked the first employee how long the wait was she said 2 hours. She then directed me to the "desk" to make my reservation. I asked the desk how long the reservation was and he said "oh about 1-2 hours... lol okay well that's a big margin.. I asked some questions about coupons to which he didn't know the answer two. The desk also told the person in front of me not to leave because they will not hold their place in line? I found this odd bc he didn't tell me this. 
Also, if you go before noon it's $27, between 12-5 it's $37 but after 5pm it's $47. Since we got there at 3pm I wanted to be sure we pay the $37 price. However, the price is NOT BASED on what time you get there...instead it's based on what time they call you after their wait. Therefore, even tho we got there at three, since t

Absolutely phenomenal food. I don't know how this place was not packed with a wait on a Saturday night. The food is that good. I got the tacos and my husband got the Arroz con Pollo. We shared each other's meals. The plantains were also delicious and I will 100% be returning.
The spot to go in the grove for a quick slice or a whole pie! Their slice/salad combo is great. The sausage pizza was delish and so was the salad. Full of flavor! *claps

It's my first night in Philadelphia and my friend just so happens to live around the corner from Bing Bing Dim Sum. We had Shane as our server and he was amazing! All of his recommendations were outstanding and he made our experience great! The menu recently changed so two of the suggestions we tried were the Brussels sprouts and the Taiwanese duck noodle soup. I will definitely be back for the soup alone! Also, the cocktails are delicious. Thank you, Shane, for a perfect first night in Philadelphia.
